## Forward-pipe operator

R now has `|>`


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rnorm(5000) %>%
  abs %>% `*` (100)  %>%
  matrix(ncol=10)  %>%
  rowMeans %>% round %>% 
  `%%`(9) %>% hist
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](R_pipeline_operator_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


## Tee operator (left)


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
rnorm(5000) %>%
  abs %>% `*` (100)  %>%
  matrix(ncol=10)  %>%
  rowMeans %>% round %>% 
  `%%`(9) %T>% hist %>% sum
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](R_pipeline_operator_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672}
